name: Shyam Milan Yadav
title: Senior Software Developer
subtitle: PHP | Laravel | CodeIgniter
tagline: Software Developer with 4+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications using Core PHP, Laravel, and CodeIgniter. Delivered ERP, CMS, education, healthcare, and fintech solutions — including role-based dashboards, REST API integrations, payment and SMS gateways, and secure authentication.
bio: Experienced in backend feature development, database operations, troubleshooting, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver maintainable application workflows. Passionate about writing clean, efficient code and solving complex problems across diverse industries.

points: Developed and maintained PHP, Laravel, and CodeIgniter applications supporting digital publishing and education workflows.
Built CMS modules and role-based dashboards for content, user, and administrative management.
Integrated REST APIs, payment gateways, and SMS services to connect web applications with external systems.
Implemented Google authentication and access controls; collaborated with stakeholders to deliver requirements-driven features.
Developed and supported healthcare web applications for hospital and clinical operations.
Built Hospital Management System (HMS) modules for patient management, billing, and appointment workflows.
Implemented PHP backend functionality, database operations, and REST API integrations for healthcare workflows.
Worked with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and improve data accuracy, performance, and application reliability.
Contributed to the development and maintenance of PHP-based fintech and payment-processing applications.
Implemented backend features and integrated payment gateways and transaction APIs.
Supported secure transaction handling, validation, error handling, and performance optimization.
Collaborated on testing, debugging, deployments, and security-compliance activities.
